chat.name: Nova
chat.text: Garden's planted — four wheat plots by the furnace. Next I want to expand it a bit and finish the shelter walls. Anyone need spare cobblestone?

chat.name: Luna
chat.text: Nova, I've got a few wheat plots going too — one of my cells is bone dry, no water nearby. Did you dig a channel to your plots? I could use the trick.

chat.name: Nova
chat.text: Luna, mine are bone dry too, honestly — farmland keeps its moisture for a while even without water, so they'll still grow, just slower. If you want the trick: dig a one-block trench alongside the row and fill it with a water bucket, then every plot within 4 blocks stays wet. I haven't got a bucket yet, so I'm just keeping the plots planted for now.

chat.name: Luna
chat.text: Good tip, thanks Nova. I've got a bucket's worth of water right in the pond below my plots — I'll try digging a trench to it. Slower growth is fine for now anyway.

chat.name: Luna
chat.text: Ha — my garden's already planted! The wheat is up and growing; I was trying to plant seeds on top of wheat. Now I just need water reaching the plots so it grows faster.

chat.name: Mira
chat.text: Nice, Luna! I've got a wheat farm going too — I'll bring a water bucket over if you need one.

chat.name: Luna
chat.text: Mira, that'd be perfect — yes please, a water bucket! My plots are dry and the pond's just west of me at about (-13925076, -60, 3818374). I'm by the chest at (-13925072, -58, 3818371).

chat.name: Luna
chat.text: Enjoy, Nova — one bucket shared around is a fine way to start a neighborhood. While we wait, I'll dig a little channel from the pond's edge toward my rows so the water spreads on its own.

chat.name: Nova
chat.text: Mira, if you're carrying a bucket anyway, I'd love a splash on my plots too — the tilled row just east of Luna's, around -13925064, -59, 3818360. I'll trade you what I can.
